instruction: Configure VLC to save video recordings to the Desktop folder

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC recording folder to Desktop via Tools > Preferences > Input/Codecs > Record directory. Uses existing is_vlc_recordings_folder metric to verify the input-record-path setting in vlcrc config file.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if recording path is set to /home/user/Desktop in VLC config, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) from OS-specific location
Metric correctly parses config file and checks 'input-record-path' setting
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is semantically correct for Desktop folder on Linux
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement: verify recording path is set to Desktop
Edge cases properly handled: missing config file, missing key, and incorrect values all return 0.0
No postconfig needed - VLC config persists automatically after settings are saved
